notes.title: Get ready for Knight Squad 2!
notes.content:
[b]Knight Squad 2[/b] is happening and we thought you might want to take a look at it. We are making this sequel following all the comments and feedback we received throughout the years. It will have new modes, new weapons, new knights, and brand new ways to customize your matches.

[h2]Watch it in action:[/h2]

[previewyoutube=WBN1XqAjl-k;full][/previewyoutube]

If you had fun with the original Knight Squad, this game is being made for you. 

We invite you to check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1048660]Knight Squad 2 Steam Page[/url] today and wishlist it if you feel like it. Every single wishlist addition we get sends the signal to Steam that our game is worth attention and this can make a big impact once we get ready to launch.

If you want to know more about the game and you'd like to have a chat with us, come hang out in our [url=www.discord.gg/chainsawesome]Discord[/url], there's always someone to chat with.

Thank you for your attention and thanks for believing in Knight Squad.

notes.title: Update #20 - Easier challenges, control remap and more!
notes.content:
[img]http://chainsawesomegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/02/update_on_steam.png[/img]

[b]Hey everyone![/b]

Who among you noble knights have completed all of the 5 single-player challenges?

Well, part or this update isn't for the masterful ones that you are. Our newest update on Steam adds an Easy difficulty setting to the challenges as well as the option to remap all the controls and new polished visual feedbacks. View the full changelist at the bottom for more infos!

Update Knight Squad now and face the slightly less unforgiving challenges!

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Added an easy mode to the challenges. The original difficulty is still available under the Insane difficulty
[*]Added the possibility to remap the controls however you like!
[*]Completely overhauled the in-game UI feedbacks to be 60 fps.
[*]Added the possibility of adding a password to your online game.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[*]Fixed an issue with the Trolls challenge
[*]Fixed the issue with the dark knights challenge where the waves upwards of 20 wouldn't save in the leaderboard
[*]Changed the way online leaving works to avoid issues.

notes.title: Update #18 - Getting closer to launch!
notes.content:
[img=http://chainsawesomegames.com/site/update_18.jpg]
Hey folks!

It's time for an update as the launch is getting closer! This update is mainly fixes and tweaks but we managed to squeeze in another challenge. Plus, we changed the challenges to be locked in a certain order if you have not finished them yet!

Here's the changes breakdown :

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Added the names of the players in the result screen.
[*]Added the new Crystalor challenge
[*]Challenges are now locked if you didn't complete the previous one. 
[*]The dark knights challenge is now the last challenge as it's the hardest.
[*]Fixed an issue in online multiplayer with grails/flags/juggernaut pickables
[*]Fixed an issue with the scores not being the same on different clients
[*]Changed how the boomerang works, you can now throw multiple at a time if you're skillful enough.
[/list]

[b]Also, keep in mind that when the game fully releases (Nov 16), all Early Access backers will receive 4 additional game modes to fiddle with.[/b]

Let us know if you have any issues with this update!

notes.title: Update #17 - FINALLY an update! Lots of stuff!
notes.content:
[img=http://chainsawesomegames.com/site/update_17.jpg]

Hey folks!

We may have looked very dead in the last couple of months but we were hard at work on the Xbox One version! With a small team, it's hard to do all at once! So here it is, update #17 :

[h1][b]Change list[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]FX trails on sword hits. Spin it and look at that cool trail!
[*]Names of the players are now shown in the UI. Know who you're up against!
[*]Changed the way the menus work. Only the first player has control over them and can go back even when there is other players in the character selection menu.
[*]Fixed the sound on the main menu intro
[*]Added the random mode
[*]Changed how the soccer is played to make it networkable.
[*][b]SOCCER IS NOW PLAYABLE ONLINE![/b]
[*]Bots showdown is now pausable and quittable
[*]Modified the dark knight challenge to remove the explosive arrows power up.
[*]Changed how the leaderboards work to add in the milliseconds for more challenge precision!
[*]Added 3 unlockable knights! The dark knight is a super easy one to unlock with how the challenges are setupped at the moment.
[*]Added achievements!
[*]Lots of online fixes and tweaks. It should be infinitely more enjoyable to play online as of now.
[*]Mac and Linux builds should hopefully be fixed. If that's not the case, make sure to throw a couple stones our way so we can fix this ASAP.
[*]Bots will now try to unfreeze themselves
[*]Bug fixes in the nest and troll challenges where you could walk off the face of the map.
[/list]


We also resetted the leaderboards since the score format has changed and that all the previous scores are now bad.

I'm most likely forgetting something but yeah it's a pretty big update nonetheless! 

Let us know what you think!

notes.content:
[img=http://chainsawesomegames.com/site/update_13.jpg]

Hello folks!

We've been working for a while in the cave on multiple new stuff for you all! We really wanted to get this out the door before the weekend so here it is! Here's a list of what's new in the build :

[h1][b]Features[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b][i]MULTIPLAYER ONLINE![/i][/b] Oh yeah the first release is here. Note that a lot of fixes and tweaks are in order and that this is the first update of many, but... it's here! P.S. The Juggernaut is pretty broken if you want to have some Wtfs going on.
[*][b]New challenges![/b] We've added 2 new challenges to the challenge list. 3 more are to come!
[*]A truck load of new maps. New maps for everyone!
[*]New animation for all the knights! We felt the knights should have a bit more personality, so we decided to give them some! Let us know which one you prefer!
[/list]

[h1][b]Bugfixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Big memory leak fix. This should fix issues where the game started running slow and doing increasingly big freezes when playing.
[*]Fixed an issue where the player could start walking very slowly for no reason.
[*]Reset all the leaderboards since the first challenge has been tweaked.
[/list]

We also came to the hard decision to drop the Tower of Destiny from the game. Read more infos on the post I'll be doing on the discussions!

Let us know what you think folks! :D

notes.title: Update #7 - New Weapon, New maps and more!
notes.content:
[img=http://chainsawesomegames.com/site/update_7_ks.jpg]

Hey guys! A new update is now live! We added a bunch of things and fixed lots of small stuff. As usual, feel free to comment on how you find the new content, we really like getting feedback to know how we should change things for the better. So here's the details :

[h1][b]Features[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Lightning rod weapon : upon hitting the first target the lightning will accelerate towards the next closest target. Go for the longest hit spree!
[*]Unicorn mount : quite simply a unicorn! Find it for a funny effect!
[*]New Maps : A new Crystal Rush and Domination map have been added to the map roster!
[*]Disable Bots : You can now disable the bots when you are 2 players or more. Simply select Disabled in the bot difficulty selector. This still needs some tuning

[list]
[*]Tweaked the colors behind the power ups

[/list]

[list]
[*]Fixed the leaderboard to show your score when you are more than 8th position.
[*]Fixed the challenge so that enemies don't spawn all with a sword.
[*]The result screen will stay the for a maximum of 30 seconds even if nobody hits a key.
[*]A draw in a team based game will now show everyone as sad.
[*]AI fix in Tug of war map
[*]When winning a round in last man standing with a horse, you will no longer look like you have a horse when respawning.
[/list]

We also removed the Kill Em' All mode since we felt it was too complicated and not that awesome. Plus it would prohibit us from adding in some new skins since the colors could end up being harder to tell in the kill em all. We will be adding a new Free For All game mode in the next update to compensate this removal.

notes.title: Update #2 - Boomerang, Horse and more!
notes.content:
[img]http://chainsawesomegames.com/site/update2KS.jpg[/img]

A new update is up and running now! We've added a couple of weapons and power ups to the game and did some minor tweaks to make the game more enjoyable! A lot of the time of the last two weeks has gone towards getting the game to work Online. This is coming together nicely. Here's what's new in the build :

[u][h1]Change Log :[/h1][/u]
[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*]New Horse power up! This sucker runs fast and will tank a hit for you! The perfect companion!
[*]New Boomerang weapon! It will always get back to you unless it hits a wall. 
[*]New Protector Gun weapon! Using this will render an ally invincible as long as you stay close to him. INVINCIBLE!
[/list]
[b]Tweaks[/b]
[list]
[*]A feedback has been added just before a power up spawn so you know in advance it will be spawning.
[*]Changed the Gladiator +1 to be +3 so they spawn less often but still give the same amount of points.
[*]Changed the color of bombs in team games. They are now the color of the team instead of the color of the player.
[*]Changed the ninja to be skeletal minions instead.
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Really fixed the controller issue with cheaper controllers.
[/list]

notes.title: Knight Squad - Update #1
notes.content:
New build is available right now! The last week has been rather hectic as we have been showing Knight Squad at E3 in the Microsoft booth, but we still managed to get some things in for the update. We also added the new [b]Challenge mode[/b]! The first level is currently very experimental and difficult so let us know what you feel about it once you've tried it!

[u][h1]Change log :[/h1][/u]
[b]New Features :[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a new Gladiator map
[*]Added a new Team Deathmatch map
[*]Added a new Last Man Standing map
[*]Added the new single player challenge menu with the first experimental challenge.
[/list]
[b]Tweaks :[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed how the bombs behave. They are now shot depending on the player's speed and explode after a short time.
[*]Bombs radius have been reduced from 4 to 2.75
[*]Added button visuals for the keyboard.
[*]Upped the Grail's value to 75 points
[*]Speeded up the Gladiator zone to give a point every 0.1 second
[/list]
[b]Fixes :[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed the controls so that cheaper controllers also work. 
[*]Fixed the issue with being able to start a Team based game without selecting a team.
[*]Fixed the Pause menu so that it would work with a player that is currently dead.
[*]Fixed the Level selection menu so that it would work with the mouse.
[*]Capped the kill streaks to a max of 7 - Extermination
[/list]
